risk_summary: The excerpt is a largely standard, detailed MD&A with meaningful quantitative disclosures on revenue, expenses, share repurchases, severance, and foreign exchange effects. Risk transparency is reasonable, although portions rely on broad management assertions and causal explanations without full quantification in the excerpt.
